summary.allegation: The issuer says the cardholder paid TerraFreight Logistics 412.75 GBP for a freight shipment that was never collected or delivered, so no service was received.
summary.to_defend: The merchant must show proof the shipment was collected and delivered before the chargeback date, to an address matching the cardholder's records.

requirements.title: Proof of delivery or service
requirements.text: Proof of delivery (tracking + carrier confirmation) or proof of service rendered (access logs, attendance, completed booking).
requirements.finding: The merchant's weekly manifest contains a consignment line, TF-9051, expressly cross referenced to this transaction (ref txn_7745MN), showing collection at 11:30 and delivery at 17:14 on 22 April 2025, signed for at destination with a POD image referenced on file.

alerts.text: The manifest records collection at 11:30 local time on 22 April 2025 (10:30 UTC), which is before the card authorisation at 10:55 UTC the same day; confirm the booking and payment sequence so the timeline reads correctly.
Evidence for R1, R2, R3 is on page 8 of 10 in Weekly freight manifest with POD line.

reasons: Every requirement the decision relies on is backed by verified evidence

justification: The manifest ties consignment TF-9051 directly to txn_7745MN with collection, delivery, signature and matching postcodes before the chargeback date.
rationale:
The issuer claims the freight shipment was never collected and no service was provided.
The merchant's operational manifest records consignment TF-9051 against transaction reference txn_7745MN, collected from LS1 4DT at 11:30 on 22 April 2025 and delivered to LS9 8AA at 17:14 the same day, signed for by warehouse staff with POD image on file.
The collection and delivery postcodes match the billing and shipping postcodes held for the 412.75 GBP transaction of 22 April 2025.
Authentication data supports the cardholder's involvement, with AVS Y, CVV M and a successful 3DS authentication.
Service was rendered on 22 April 2025, three weeks before the 14 May 2025 chargeback, so the case should be represented, ideally with the POD-9051 image attached.
